title: Growth at every depth from forgetting blocks
claim: Theorem F: if every composition of r consecutive block steps (orbit to child orbit, side subtrees feasible) is rectangular, L_N(k, s) >= 1 + ceil(s/r) at every s and depth (from BRANCH-DEPTH-20261112-001A's splicing lemma). Lemma U: projections onto addresses at level <= m are the same for every N >= m + r0, so depth-9 bonds bound the reach at every depth. Computed: all 399 small-orbit rulers (r = 1/2/3: 228/152/19; cyclic ones mostly r = 2), all 43 half-rate and 6 of 8 undecided grow at every depth; 42 direct and 4 others never forget. Referee pending.
failure_conditions: A small-orbit census description whose reach at some depth is below 1 + ceil(s/r).
A composed window relation that differs from the SAT projection of its sub-pattern.
A depth-9 least bond with members at level <= 9 - r0 whose projection changes at a larger depth.
remaining_obligations: Exact rates (the bound is one below the census for r = 1; rate 1/2 or 1/3 otherwise).
Four small-orbit descriptions that never forget and are not direct.
foundation_claim_scope: The plain not-all-equal law; addressed patterns placed by automaton maps, knots within a level or between adjacent levels.
